# Prompt Engineering

> > A comprehensive resource for mastering prompt engineering, large language models (LLMs), and generative AI applications across ChatGPT, GPT-4, Claude, Gemini, and other leading AI platforms.

Prompt Engineering is an educational platform founded by Sunil Ramlochan, offering strategic guides, technical documentation, and industry analysis for professionals working with generative AI technologies. The site provides actionable frameworks for prompt design, LLM implementation, and AI adoption in business contexts.

## Key Topics

- Prompt Engineering
- Large Language Models (LLMs)
- Generative AI (GenAI)
- ChatGPT
- GPT-4
- Claude
- Gemini
- OpenAI
- AI Framework Development
- LLM Applications
- Workflow Optimization
- AI Adoption Strategies
- AI Limitations and Risks
- Business Intelligence
- Strategic Planning with AI

- [Fundamental Abilities of Production Ready Large Language Models](https://promptengineering.org/fundamental-abilities-of-large-language-models): Core LLM capabilities for production: summarization, NER, sentiment analysis
